{{/* crest-help: renders terminal-style help output. Bolds ALL-CAPS heading lines and backtick-wrapped tokens to mirror what the Crest help renderer does in a real terminal. */}} {{- $c := .Inner | htmlEscape -}} {{- $c = replaceRE `(?m)^([A-Z][A-Z0-9 -]*)$` "$1" $c -}} {{- $c = replaceRE "`([^`]+)`" "$1" $c -}} 
{{ $c | safeHTML }}
